description: This file contains global exception handlers for a FastAPI application, including handling for HTTP exceptions, validation errors, and generic unhandled exceptions, with structured JSON responses and logging.

methods.name: JSONResponse _problem_response(status_code: int, detail: Any, *, extra: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a JSON response following a problem schema, including status code, detail, and optional extra information.

methods.name: JSONResponse http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: StarletteHTTPException)
methods.description: Handles HTTP exceptions from FastAPI/Starlette and returns a structured JSON response.

methods.name: JSONResponse validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError)
methods.description: Handles validation errors, normalizing them into a JSON response with error details.

methods.name: JSONResponse generic_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception)
methods.description: Handles unexpected exceptions, logging the error and returning a generic 500 response.
